title: Discharge Training Percentage for Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Months
content:
# Discharge Training Percentage — Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Months

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month paid in full by the coverage, the amount is multiplied by:

- **105 percent** when the initial-setup delivery came before the setup date on the oxygen record and the order came from a hospital discharge;
- **103 percent** when the initial-setup delivery came before the setup date and the order came from a skilled nursing facility;
- **100 percent** otherwise.

The initial-setup delivery date is read from the patient's oxygen service history; the setup date and the referral source are read from the oxygen record. "Before" means at least one calendar day earlier. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Truth table

| Initial-setup delivery before the setup date | Referral source | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | hospital discharge | 105 |
| yes | skilled nursing facility | 103 |
| yes | any other source | 100 |
| no (same day as the setup date) | any | 100 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Initial-setup delivery 3 June, setup date 5 June, hospital discharge referral: 105 percent.
- Initial-setup delivery 10 September, setup date 11 September, skilled nursing facility referral: 103 percent.
- Initial-setup delivery and setup date both 14 May, hospital discharge referral: 100 percent.
- An amount of 172.61 at 105 percent is 181.2405, carried unrounded.
